main_idea: GRPO lifted Qwen3.8-27B DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO raises DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points
Training used 500 expert-authored software engineering tasks
Tasks come from private, enterprise-grade codebases
Eight attempts per task, GRPO updates all parameters
Training ran for 15 updates across 422 repositories
summary: The bar chart is clear and complete, but a slogan headline, kicker, header tag, stats row, method cards, and repeated footer brand lines clutter it.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: AfterQuery logo
regions.reason: One brand mark, small and quiet, identifies the source.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: DeepSWE bar chart
regions.reason: Main visual: labelled bars, axis, metric title, and change annotation.

regions.label: red
regions.name: header category tag
regions.reason: Section tag 'Research note / DeepSWE' tells the reader nothing new.

regions.label: red
regions.name: eyebrow kicker line
regions.reason: Category kicker above the headline; the chart already names the metric.

regions.label: red
regions.name: slogan headline
regions.reason: Slogan that does not state the finding; the chart carries the result.

regions.label: orange
regions.name: subtitle with method facts
regions.reason: Carries real facts (method, task count); fold into chart title or footnote.

regions.label: red
regions.name: base-to-step pill
regions.reason: Repeats the 'Base model' and 'Step 15' bar labels already on the chart.

regions.label: red
regions.name: dataset stats row
regions.reason: Dataset and update counts serve a second point, not reading the bars.

regions.label: orange
regions.name: method and data cards
regions.reason: Method and data details matter but take whole cards; shrink to a footnote.

regions.label: red

regions.label: red

regions.reason: Tagline with no bearing on the measured result.
